focus.zh: 台灣與東南亞半導體、伺服器系統、工廠供電及產業投資
focus.en: Taiwan and Southeast Asian semiconductors, server systems, factory power and industrial investment

throughline.zh: 台灣公布外銷訂單、製造業產值及封測擴產核准案，美國新晶片法規開始適用，東南亞資料中心與區域電網則分別揭露開發規模和電力合作安排。
throughline.en: Taiwan reported export orders, factory output and packaging investment approvals; U.S. chip rules took effect, while Asia-Pacific data centers and regional power-grid partners disclosed development and cooperation plans.

text.zh: 經濟部公布 10 月外銷訂單 1,238.2 億美元、年增 78.3%，資通訊和電子產品接單均增，但尚未等同出口實績。
text.en: October export orders reached US$123.82bn, up 78.3% YoY, led by ICT and electronics; the figure measures orders, not delivered exports.

text.zh: 福懋科斗六封測擴產計畫獲審查通過，擬投入近 111.9 億元、增加 583 個工作機會，量產尚未完成。
text.en: Formosa Advanced Technologies' proposed NT$11.19bn packaging expansion cleared investment review, with 583 planned jobs and no commissioned capacity yet.

text.zh: 美國 BIS 新規在 11/19 生效；台積電 11/20 確認依法遵循，部分對中停單範圍仍是媒體引述，尚無公司確認。
text.en: The BIS rule took effect November 19; TSMC affirmed compliance November 20, while alleged China order suspensions remain anonymously sourced.

text.zh: 雲豹能源稱台灣與亞太開發超過 10 座 AI 資料中心、規模逾 300MW，尚未揭露逐案併網與商轉資料。
text.en: J&V Energy reports over ten AI data-center projects totaling more than 300MW in development, without site-level commissioning evidence.

text.zh: 6G-FORMOSA 實驗網於竹東啟用，18 家產學研參與、累計服務 20 家驗測業者，屬研發測試設施。
text.en: The Zhudong 6G-FORMOSA testbed launched with 18 partners and 20 firms supported, representing R&D testing rather than commercial deployment.

title.zh: 經濟部公布 10 月外銷訂單 1,238.2 億美元，電子與資通訊產品接單增加
title.en: Taiwan October export orders reach US$123.82bn, led by electronics and ICT products

summary.zh: 經濟部 11 月 20 日公布，台灣 2026 年 10 月外銷訂單達 1,238.2 億美元，年增 78.3%；前十月累計 9,430.2 億美元、年增 58.6%。10 月電子產品接單 539.1 億美元，資訊通信產品接單 467.7 億美元，其中包含晶片、伺服器等產品，但接單金額尚不等同已完成出口或晶片驗收。
summary.en: Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs reported US$123.82 billion of export orders for October on November 20, up 78.3% YoY, bringing January–October orders to US$943.02 billion, up 58.6%. October electronics orders were US$53.91 billion and ICT orders US$46.77 billion; order values covering chips and computing systems are distinct from completed exports and customer acceptance.

text.zh: 外銷訂單調查衡量台灣廠商接獲的海外訂單，涵蓋晶片設計、電子零組件、伺服器及通訊產品。若同一批商品跨境委外生產、出貨或銷售，外銷訂單與海關出口統計在期間、母體和認列方式上不同。
text.en: Export-order surveys capture foreign orders received by Taiwanese firms, covering chip design, components, servers and communications. They differ from customs shipments in population, production location and timing.

text.zh: 經濟部資料經中央社報導，10 月資訊通信產品 467.7 億美元、年增 107.2%；電子產品 539.1 億美元、年增 89.8%；機械產品 24.4 億美元、年增 36.3%。東協接單 287.8 億美元、年增 92.2%，不能和按產品分類數字相加，因兩者分類維度不同。
text.en: CNA reports October ICT orders of US$46.77 billion, up 107.2%; electronics US$53.91 billion, up 89.8%; and machinery US$2.44 billion, up 36.3%. Orders from ASEAN reached US$28.78 billion, up 92.2%. Geographic and product categories overlap and must not be added together.

text.zh: 統計處對 11 月預估接單 1,150 億至 1,187 億美元，年增 57.6% 至 62.7%；相較之下 10 月和前十月為已公告統計。預估不構成已簽訂或已交付的逐公司設備採購。
text.en: The statistics office forecast November orders between US$115.0 billion and US$118.7 billion, up 57.6%–62.7%. October and year-to-date values are reported statistics, while November remains an official estimate.

text.zh: 個別廠商的出貨、晶圓測試及驗收金額未揭露，且尚未取得 11 月 20 日可逐欄核對的完整原始統計表。
text.en: Firm-level shipments, chip-testing acceptance and customer receipts were not provided, and the complete original November 20 statistical table was not independently retrieved.

title.zh: 福懋科技斗六封測擴產獲投資台灣方案審查通過，規劃投入近 111.9 億元
title.en: Formosa Advanced Technologies' Douliu packaging expansion clears investment review, with NT$11.19bn planned

summary.zh: 投資台灣事務所 11 月 20 日通過福懋科技在雲林斗六的封裝測試擴產，計畫投入近新台幣 111.9 億元，增加 DDR4 等產品封測代工與高階 IC 封測產線，預計新增 583 個本國工作機會。同日合計通過 5 案、新增規劃金額約 126 億元；這些是審查通過的投資計畫，尚未公開擴產後每月實際出貨或客戶驗收數量。
summary.en: Taiwan's investment office approved a proposed NT$11.19 billion Formosa Advanced Technologies packaging and test expansion in Douliu, Yunlin, on November 20. The project covers DDR4 and other mainstream products alongside advanced IC test, with 583 expected domestic jobs. Five plans totaling about NT$12.6 billion were approved the same day, but production and customer acceptance have not been reported.

text.zh: 福懋科提供記憶體封裝、測試及模組委外服務。經濟部對 DDR4 供給的說明指出，上游原廠分配較多資源至 HBM 與 DDR5，是此次投資案的公司及政府背景判斷，未附各種記憶體的實際短缺位元數。
text.en: Formosa Advanced Technologies provides packaging, test and module outsourcing for memory. The ministry attributes the DDR4 investment rationale to producers prioritizing HBM and DDR5, without quantifying bit-level shortages.

text.zh: 公司規劃於雲林斗六既有廠區擴充 DDR4 封測代工，另建置高階 IC 封測產線。投資額近 111.9 億元與預估新增 583 人屬申請案規劃，不代表已完成資本支出或正式聘僱。
text.en: The expansion targets its existing Douliu campus. The near-NT$11.19 billion budget and 583 planned hires are project estimates, not completed spending or employment.

text.zh: 經濟部同日表示合一特用材料規劃約 3.8 億元建置高純度合金靶材產線並回收使用後殘靶，預計增聘 84 人。這是另一家公司、另一類設備和材料專案，列於同日五案但不併入福懋科預算。
text.en: A separate applicant, He Yi Specialty Materials, proposed around NT$380 million for high-purity sputtering targets and spent-target recycling, with 84 expected jobs. Its budget is part of the same five-plan announcement but not Formosa Advanced Technologies' own spending.

text.zh: 斗六新增產線的正式開機、月封測量、資本支出支付進度及客戶驗收未公開；原始審查清冊未獨立取得。
text.en: Commissioning dates, monthly packaging and test volume, spending disbursements and customer acceptance are not public. The original approval table was not independently retrieved.

title.zh: 追蹤：美國高階晶片遠端算力新規已生效，台積電回應將遵循適用法令
title.en: Follow-up: U.S. advanced-chip remote-compute rule takes effect as TSMC affirms compliance

summary.zh: 美國 BIS 高階晶片及遠端算力暫行最終規則刊登於 11 月 19 日聯邦公報，官方文件載明當日生效；台積電 11 月 20 日回應，已知悉新規並將遵守適用法令。路透引述知情人士稱部分中國客戶 16 奈米及以下製程訂單遭暫停，台積電表示不評論市場傳聞，停單的個別客戶及數量尚無公司確認。
summary.en: The U.S. BIS interim final rule on advanced semiconductors and remote computing was published in the Federal Register on November 19 and states an effective date of the same day. TSMC said on November 20 it was aware of the regulations and would comply with applicable law. Reuters sources alleged suspension of some China-linked orders at 16nm and below, which TSMC has not independently confirmed.

label.zh: 官方法規範圍與生效日期

text.zh: 聯邦公報第 91 卷 74970 頁文件列出 2026 年 11 月 19 日正式生效，將特定高階晶片輸往星馬泰印等目的地與受管制企業透過海外資料中心取得算力等情況納入許可和終端使用者查核，並保有適用範圍與例外條件。
text.en: The Federal Register, 91 FR 74970, states the rule took effect November 19. It introduces licensing and due diligence for specified advanced chips sent to named destinations and certain offshore compute supplied to restricted end users, with defined exceptions.

label.zh: 台積電回應與媒體指控區分

text.zh: 中央社 11 月 20 日引述台積電回應：公司已知 BIS 新規，將遵守適用法律，不評論市場傳聞。路透引述匿名人士報導可能涉及 16 奈米以下或 16 奈米製程、以及部分使用 HBM 與先進封裝的中國客戶。這些具體訂單停止範圍仍屬路透消息來源主張，不能當成台積電確認的停單清單。
text.en: CNA quoted TSMC as acknowledging the BIS rule, promising compliance and declining comment on rumors. Reuters separately cited anonymous sources alleging affected 16nm-and-below designs and further restrictions involving HBM or advanced packaging. Those customer-level suspensions are not confirmed TSMC announcements.

label.zh: 對晶圓及封裝業務的適用界線

text.zh: 實際許可判斷需查產品出口管制分類、終端客戶所在地及最終母公司、技術用途和供應鏈運送路徑。尚無公開資料可將規則直接換算成特定台灣晶圓廠或設備商的已取消訂單金額。
text.en: License applicability depends on control classification, end-user headquarters and ownership, the compute use case and shipment paths. No verified Taiwan-specific cancellations or tool-order reductions have been quantified.

text.zh: 路透所述受影響客戶、製程數量、已取得許可件數與實際晶片交貨變動，尚待正式文件。
text.en: Affected customer identities, wafer volumes, license grants and actual delivery changes await documented evidence.

ceoView.zh: 對半導體製程電源、晶圓量測及資料中心電力設備供應商而言，新規涉及產品分類、最終使用者和跨境存取。仍須核對具體客戶許可文件、實際訂單及交付紀錄，匿名報導不能用來量化設備出貨變動。
ceoView.en: For process-power, wafer metrology and data-center electrical-equipment suppliers, the rule affects classification, end users and cross-border compute access. Customer licensing, contracted orders and shipment records remain essential; anonymous reporting does not quantify equipment-delivery changes.

title.zh: 雲豹能源披露台灣與亞太 AI 資料中心逾 10 案、逾 300MW 開發規劃
title.en: J&V Energy reports more than ten AI data-center projects exceeding 300MW in its Asia development pipeline

summary.zh: 雲豹能源 11 月 19 日法說表示，於台灣與亞太地區推動超過 10 座 AI 資料中心開發專案，規模逾 300MW，並規劃於今年啟動統包建置；目前屬開發中案場，尚未列出逐案取得供電許可、簽訂施工或商用運轉的容量。公司前三季合併營收 51.87 億元，售電收入 27.82 億元。
summary.en: J&V Energy said at its November 19 briefing that more than ten AI data-center projects totaling over 300MW are under development in Taiwan and Asia-Pacific, with design-build work targeted to start during 2026. These are pipeline figures, not permitted or commissioned data-center load. Nine-month group revenue was NT$5.187 billion, including NT$2.782 billion of electricity sales.

label.zh: 資料中心與電力基礎設施

text.zh: 公司規劃結合綠電供應、儲能工程、能源管理與 AIDC 建置，服務項目延伸至算力租賃。300MW 為跨多個預計場址的開發規模，未說明是 IT 負載、全站用電或已取得併網核可的容量。
text.en: The group proposes linking renewable electricity, storage, energy management, data-center construction and compute leasing. The 300MW figure spans planned sites; the release does not define it as commissioned IT load, grid-approved capacity or total site power.

label.zh: 已公布財務與儲能進度

text.zh: 中央社引述公司前三季營收 51.87 億元，售電 27.82 億元、工程收入 15.30 億元。台普威在日本的 13 座併網儲能場址屬既有營運成果；台灣及亞太 AIDC 開發案的運轉收入未分列。
text.en: CNA reports nine-month revenue of NT$5.187 billion, including NT$2.782 billion from electricity and NT$1.530 billion from engineering. Thirteen commissioned Japanese storage sites are existing operations, separate from prospective Taiwan/Asia data centers.

text.zh: 公司表示越南及菲律賓光電專案已於今年第一季開始貢獻收入，與資料中心專案未必同址、同類型。尚無逐座資料中心地點、施工許可、用電協議、採購合約及實際併網資料。
text.en: The company says solar projects in Vietnam and the Philippines began contributing revenue in Q1, separate from the data-center pipeline. Data-center locations, permits, power-purchase agreements, procurement and grid connections were not provided.

text.zh: 逾 10 案的個別地點、正式負載口徑、資金承諾、確定施工及客戶驗收尚未公開。
text.en: Individual site locations, load definitions, financing commitments, signed construction and customer acceptance remain undisclosed.

title.zh: 經濟部公布第三季製造業產值 7.5079 兆元、年增 43.09%，電子零組件為主要成長來源
title.en: Taiwan Q3 manufacturing output reaches NT$7.5079tn, up 43.09% YoY

summary.zh: 經濟部統計處 11 月 19 日公布 2026 年第三季製造業產值 7 兆 5,079 億元、年增 43.09%；電子零組件業年增 52.18%，電腦電子及光學製品年增 129.78%。產值受產品價格及生產數量共同影響，若改看剔除價格因素的製造業生產指數，當季為 145.59、年增 23.14%，兩種指標不可互代。
summary.en: Taiwan's MOEA reported NT$7.5079 trillion of Q3 manufacturing output on November 19, up 43.09% YoY. Electronic components grew 52.18%, and computers, electronics and optical products grew 129.78%. The Q3 manufacturing production index was 145.59, up 23.14% YoY, a price-adjusted volume measure distinct from nominal output value.

text.zh: 整體製造業產值涵蓋電子零組件、電腦電子、化學、機械及其他產業，與先前 TSIA 公布的半導體產值涵蓋範圍不同。統計處將電子零組件及電腦電子相關變動與晶片、雲端基礎設施和設備投資連結，但未分別給出單一晶圓廠的產出。
text.en: The total covers electronics, machinery, chemicals and broader manufacturing. It differs from TSIA's narrower semiconductor industry output. MOEA attributes part of the change to electronics and cloud infrastructure without fab-level output counts.

text.zh: 第三季積體電路產值年增 59.18%、機械設備年增 22.67%、化學材料及肥料年增 13.5%。製造業生產指數 145.59、年增 23.14%，較名目產值的 43.09% 不同；不能將兩者視為同一成長率或相加。
text.en: IC manufacturing output value rose 59.18% YoY; machinery equipment 22.67% and chemicals and fertilizers 13.5%. The manufacturing production index grew 23.14%, against 43.09% growth in nominal output value, reflecting differing measures.

text.zh: 原始產品別產值明細表及各企業實際產能、出貨和設備驗收並未逐項取得。
text.en: The complete original category table and company-level capacity, shipments and tool acceptance were not independently obtained.

title.zh: 台灣 6G-FORMOSA 實驗網在竹東啟用，18 家產學研參與、累計服務 20 家驗測業者
title.en: Taiwan commissions 6G-FORMOSA test network with 18 partners and 20 users

summary.zh: 工研院與經濟部、國科會 11 月 20 日在新竹竹東啟用 6G-FORMOSA 實驗網，結合 18 家國內外產學研夥伴、五項技術主題，並表示已協助 20 家業者進行技術驗測。示範包含手機直連衛星傳送訊息與通訊感測融合，屬研發測試環境，尚未等同正式 6G 商用部署或國際標準已定案。
summary.en: Taiwan's ITRI and government partners launched the 6G-FORMOSA test network in Zhudong on November 20, involving 18 research and industry partners across five technology themes and 20 firms receiving testing support. Demonstrations include direct satellite messaging and integrated sensing and communication. The facility is for R&D testing, not commercial 6G deployment or a finalized global standard.

text.zh: 實驗網串連聯發科、和碩、明泰、啟碁等通訊與電子系統參與者，提供 6G 晶片、網路設備、射頻量測、AI 無線接取網路及非地面網路的整合驗測。
text.en: Participants include MediaTek, Pegatron and communications-equipment suppliers, covering chip and RF testing, AI radio networks and non-terrestrial connectivity.

label.zh: 已完成測試與後續計畫

text.zh: 經濟部引述工研院說明，國內 20 家業者已使用平台驗測，並完成低空無人機偵測與衛星直連緊急訊息兩項跨國協作驗證；2027 年台歐 6G 聯合徵案仍是規劃。
text.en: The program reports 20 users and two international demonstrations involving low-altitude drone detection and satellite-connected emergency messaging. A proposed 2027 Taiwan-EU 6G call remains planned.

text.zh: 各項測試的 RF 誤差、晶片出貨量、設備採購價與商用網路驗收日期尚未揭露。
text.en: RF accuracy, commercial chip shipments, test-equipment procurement values and network acceptance dates were not published.

title.zh: 和碩表示 70 家關鍵供應商達成無碳能源專案目標，累計使用 4,097 萬度電力
title.en: Pegatron says 70 key suppliers reached its carbon-free electricity target, with 40.97m kWh used

summary.zh: 和碩 11 月 20 日公布，旗下無碳能源供應商計畫已有 70 家關鍵供應商達成專案設定的 100% 無碳能源使用目標，累計使用 4,097 萬度無碳電力。這是公司對參與供應商的計畫成果陳述，未公布每家廠商的測量期間、用電基數或第三方逐廠查核數據，不能直接理解為和碩全球所有供應商都使用 100% 無碳電力。
summary.en: Pegatron reported on November 20 that 70 selected key suppliers had met its program's 100% carbon-free electricity target, representing 40.97 million kWh of electricity use. These are company-reported program results, with no site-by-site measurement period, baseline or independent audit disclosed. The statement does not cover all Pegatron suppliers worldwide.

text.zh: 和碩的供應鏈涵蓋電子組裝、車用電子、伺服器及零組件廠。無碳能源計畫是特定關鍵供應商的用電轉型，與當年度各供應商總能耗、保證書適用範圍及各電網供電方式仍應分開核對。
text.en: Pegatron's suppliers span electronics assembly, automotive and server components. The program applies to selected suppliers and does not itself establish their total site electricity demand or accounting treatment by grid and certificate.

text.zh: 公司表示 11 月 13 日及 18 日與 SGS 舉行供應商活動，並於 20 日公布 70 家關鍵供應商及 4,097 萬度成果，另發布新版供應商行為準則及品質評鑑標準。數據是既有專案累計，無需視為 11 月 20 日新增的設備產能。
text.en: Supplier events took place November 13 and 18 with SGS; the company disclosed the 70-supplier and 40.97-million-kWh program figures on November 20, along with updated supplier conduct and quality standards. The usage is cumulative rather than newly installed electrical capacity.

text.zh: 專案逐廠用電基準期間、能源來源結構、獨立確信邊界與實際減碳量未完整公布。
text.en: Per-site baseline periods, energy mix, assurance boundaries and measured emissions reduction are not fully published.

ceoView.zh: 對伺服器電源、工廠電能管理與電力品質量測供應商而言，和碩提供了參與者及累計用電數據。還需要各工廠電力負載、電能憑證、實體設備及查核範圍，才能比較相關系統部署；該計畫並未揭露機櫃或工具採購量。
ceoView.en: For server power, factory energy management and electrical metrology suppliers, Pegatron disclosed program participation and cumulative electricity usage. Site loads, certificates, equipment and assurance boundaries remain necessary; the program does not reveal rack or tool purchases.

title.zh: 追蹤：新加坡提出東協電網跨境電力交易願景，合作備忘錄此前已生效
title.en: Follow-up: Singapore outlines ASEAN grid investment priorities after existing power-trade MoU

summary.zh: 新加坡能源與工業部長陳詩龍於 11 月 13 日接受訪問，其談話於 11 月 20 日發布，說明政府希望 2027 年擔任東協主席時推進跨境電力交易，並保留各國優先供應國內需求的原則。東協增強版電網合作備忘錄已在 11 月 15 日完成簽署及生效，本次新增的是新加坡對區域電力合作與投資的公開說明，尚無具名輸電線路或新設備合約金額。
summary.en: Singapore's Minister for Energy and Industry Tan See Leng spoke to reporters on November 13, with the interview published November 20. He outlined a goal to advance ASEAN cross-border electricity trade during Singapore's 2027 chairmanship while respecting each member's domestic energy needs. The enhanced ASEAN Power Grid MoU had already entered into force on November 15; the new reporting covers Singapore's policy priorities, without named transmission projects or contracted equipment values.

label.zh: 電網與資料中心用電背景

text.zh: 跨國電網須協調輸電線、海底電纜、電網調度、價格及跨境許可，直接涉及東南亞工廠與資料中心電力供給。合作備忘錄設定自願、分階段整合的政策框架，未直接等同任何國家承諾輸出特定電量。
text.en: Cross-border transmission requires grid links, subsea cables, dispatch systems, prices and permits, relevant to Southeast Asian factories and data centers. The existing MoU establishes voluntary, phased cooperation without committing a fixed electricity export volume.

text.zh: Channel NewsAsia 11 月 20 日報導，陳詩龍強調區域電力合作應先顧及各國本地能源需求，並希望在 2027 年輪值主席任期內推動經濟及投資合作。訪問實際進行於 11 月 13 日，新發布的是談話內容。
text.en: Channel NewsAsia published Tan's remarks on November 20, emphasizing that domestic electricity needs come first and regional interconnection can support investment. The interview itself occurred November 13.

text.zh: 新加坡新增進口電量、具名跨境輸電線路成本、完工期及多邊電力交易實際量未在訪問中公布。
text.en: New import volumes, project-level transmission costs, completion schedules and actual multilateral power trades were not disclosed.

timing.en: Interview November 13, first reported November 20; ASEAN MoU completed November 15.

unknowns.en: No newly contracted project, installed line capacity or commercial power trade was identified.

ceoView.zh: 對電網電力轉換、工業電力品質量測和資料中心供電設備供應商而言，新加坡的政策說明仍停留在跨境電網制度與融資協調階段。需確認具體互聯線路、電壓與輸電規格、投資承諾及驗收，尚無可轉為設備訂單的數據。
ceoView.en: For grid conversion, industrial power-quality metrology and data-center electrical suppliers, Singapore's statements concern policy and financing coordination. Named links, voltage ratings, funded contracts and acceptance remain necessary; no tool-order values are established.

question.zh: 外銷訂單、製造業產值與出口值能直接加總嗎？
question.en: Can export orders, manufacturing output and customs exports be added together?

text.zh: 三者統計母體和認列時點不同。外銷訂單衡量台灣廠商新接海外訂單，製造業產值是第三季名目生產價值，出口值才是海關貨物移動統計，不可直接加總或當成同一需求。
text.en: No. Export orders measure foreign orders received by firms, manufacturing output measures quarterly nominal production, and customs exports record shipped goods. Their populations and periods differ.

question.zh: 福懋科核准投資近 111.9 億元，表示新封測產線已開始出貨嗎？
question.en: Does the approved NT$11.19bn Formosa plan establish new packaging shipments?

text.zh: 核准的是投資計畫，包含 DDR4 與高階 IC 封測。新增產線建置、良率與客戶驗收仍待後續文件，不能以審查金額代替已實現的出貨。
text.en: No. The amount refers to an approved investment plan for DDR4 and advanced IC test. New line commissioning, yields and customer acceptance remain unreported.

question.zh: 16 奈米以下訂單全面暫停是否已由台積電證實？
question.en: Has TSMC confirmed a blanket halt of all 16nm-and-below orders?

text.zh: 台積電確認知悉新規並將遵守適用法令，但對路透引述匿名人士的特定中國客戶停單範圍不評論。聯邦公報可確認規則於 11/19 生效，仍需逐產品、終端用途與許可條件核對。
text.en: TSMC confirmed awareness and compliance with the rule but declined to verify Reuters' anonymous-source account of affected China orders. The Federal Register establishes the November 19 effective date, while product and end-use applicability require individual assessment.

title.zh: 東協電網合作備忘錄的既有進度

text.zh: 東協秘書處於 2026 年 11 月 15 日公告已完成增強版東協電網合作備忘錄簽署，並依完成簽署生效。11 月 20 日新加坡媒體公開的是能源部長先前訪談的政策說明，不能當成當日新簽協定。
text.en: The ASEAN Secretariat announced completion and entry into force of the enhanced Power Grid MoU on November 15. Singapore's November 20 coverage concerns a previously recorded ministerial interview, not a new signature.

title.zh: 重複的伺服器展覽與調價展望
title.en: Repeated server exhibits and pricing outlooks

text.zh: 華碩 11/20 台灣新聞稿重述先前 SC26 英文發布的 Vera Rubin 機櫃與測試架構；因未增加可獨立確認的出貨台數或客戶驗收，不再作為新事件。股價與分析師估值變動也未納入。
text.en: ASUS' November 20 Taiwanese release reiterated an earlier SC26 global announcement without new verifiable rack shipments or customer acceptances, and stock-price or analyst valuation commentary was not treated as a new event.

title.zh: 較早公布的越南氣候科技統計

text.zh: 11 月 20 日報導引用本月初發布的越南氣候科技融資報告，主要數字來自先前年度及舊報告；缺少新增的能源設施交付或合約，故保留為較低優先度。
text.en: November 20 coverage cited a climate-tech financing report released earlier in the month, with historical figures but no newly completed electricity infrastructure project or signed contract.

verificationNote.zh: 外銷訂單、製造業產值及投資台灣個案數值由媒體轉述經濟部，尚未逐欄取得當日原始表格；已保留來源限制。美國晶片規則於 11/19 正式生效，台積電只確認依法遵循，匿名消息所述停單範圍未經公司證實。雲豹能源逾 300MW 為開發規劃，和碩無碳能源成果及 6G 實驗網數據亦分別屬公司或政府報告。
verificationNote.en: MOEA export-order, manufacturing and investment figures are attributed through news reporting; original line-by-line tables were not independently obtained. The BIS rule took effect November 19, but TSMC did not confirm the anonymously reported order suspensions. J&V's 300MW is a development pipeline, while Pegatron's electricity program and the 6G testbed counts are reported program results.
